Hamilton · ref. H64475131

Khaki King

Field · 37–40mm · 50m, with some recent models updated to 100m · automatic · 2019–2026

The Khaki King is a versatile and robust field watch known for its military-inspired design and a signature day-date complication with the full day displayed in an arc at 12 o'clock.

The story

The Khaki King's heritage stems from the field watches Hamilton produced for the U.S. military, dating back to World War II. After the war, the design was adapted for the civilian market, retaining its durability and legibility. Over the years, the Khaki King has evolved from smaller, more purely military-styled pieces to the modern 40mm versions. A key turning point was the introduction of the 'Khaki King II' and the transition from standard ETA movements to the Hamilton-specific H-series calibers with an extended 80-hour power reserve.
